## Summary Depends on #31537 and #31566. STANDALONE spec decoding and DP attention are mutually exclusive. This PR enables STANDALONE spec decoding with DP attention, validated under `topk == 1` and `attn_tp_size == 1`. ### NOTE - This PR focuses on correctness only. - **Gated:** `topk > 1` and partial DP (`attn_tp_size > 1`). - **Not verified (untested, not gated):** PD disagg, non-fa3/triton backends, MoE draft. ## Modifications - **Enable STANDALONE + DP attention** - Narrow down `ValueError` guard in `_handle_eagle_family`, enabling STANDALONE + DP attention with `topk == 1` and `attn_tp_size == 1`. - Handle `NoneType` hidden states across DP pad/unpad in `ForwardBatch`. - Track `num_tokens_before_dp_padding` before DP padding to unpad draft forward after MLP all-gather. - Load and run draft inside the attention-TP group. - Remove `StandaloneDraftWorker`'s `init_attention_backends` / `init_cuda_graphs` overrides (avoid double-wrapping). - Add `num_tokens_before_dp_padding` to the TBO child allow list in `filter_batch`, so the new field (`None` on the child, set later by the child's own padding) can pass "unsupported field" check. - **Add an e2e test:** test GSM8K accuracy + `accept_length` under concurrency and a bs=1 accept length check; add default model constants for STANDALONE + DP attn. ## Accuracy Tests 0.950 vs 0.945 is within GSM8K noise at this sample size; `accept_length` ~4.00 confirms spec decoding remains effective under DP attention. #### Accuracy Parity & Spec Effectiveness - Setup: - Runpod 4× RTX PRO 4500 + triton backend - `Qwen3-30B-A3B` as the target and `Qwen3-0.6B` as the draft - **Verified:** topk=1, triton (local Blackwell) - **Pending:** fa3 (H100); need CI | Config | GSM8K Acc | Avg Accept Length | Screenshot | Steps | |---|---|---|---|---| | STANDALONE **+ DP attn** (`tp4 / dp4`) | **0.950** | **4.0038** | | 1. [launch_dp.sh](https://gist.github.com/JiangJiaWei1103/c2cded820d48157c6a4b28b65db6a3c0#file-launch_dp-sh)
2. [run_gsm8k.sh](https://gist.github.com/JiangJiaWei1103/c2cded820d48157c6a4b28b65db6a3c0#file-run_gsm8k-sh) | | STANDALONE, **no DP attn** (`tp4`) | **0.945** | **3.9462** | | 1. [launch_nodp.sh](https://gist.github.com/JiangJiaWei1103/c2cded820d48157c6a4b28b65db6a3c0#file-launch_nodp-sh)
2. [run_gsm8k.sh](https://gist.github.com/JiangJiaWei1103/c2cded820d48157c6a4b28b65db6a3c0#file-run_gsm8k-sh) | #### CI Run [run_ci.sh](https://gist.github.com/JiangJiaWei1103/c2cded820d48157c6a4b28b65db6a3c0#file-run_ci-sh) locally: - `test_a_gsm8k` (high concurrency, `num_threads=128`): guard batch exceeding captured buckets; assert `score > 0.90` and `accept_length > 3.5` - `test_b_bs1_acc_length` (single request, bs=1): exercise the idle-DP-rank path (bs=1 with dp>1 leaves ranks idle); assert `acc_length > 3.0`; no speed assertion. #### EAGLE + DP Attention Run `test_eagle_dp_attention.py` to prove there's no regression: ## Speed Tests and Profiling Out of scope; this PR focuses on correctness only. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #29805571613](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/29805571613) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #29805571502](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/29805571502)

Hi @Qiaolin-Yu,

This enables STANDALONE spec decoding under DP attention and two latent bugs are fixed here:

- NCCL hang at idle DP ranks (`capture_hidden_mode` mismatch)
- Batch size exceeds the captured CUDA-graph buckets in the draft-extend runner

GSM8K is on par with the non-dp baseline. Failed CI is gated by the `run-ci` label. PTAL when you get a chance. Thank you!

Thanks @JiangJiaWei1103. Closing this because it has had no updates in 91 days.

Reopen it if the work is still relevant.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),
`bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.

## Code Review

This pull request enables support for standalone speculative decoding with DP (Data Parallel) attention. It removes the previous restriction, handles cases where standalone mode lacks hidden states or backup hidden states, configures the correct capture hidden mode for idle ranks to prevent NCCL hangs, and runs the draft worker in the attention TP group when DP attention is enabled. A test suite is also added to verify the implementation. The reviewer suggests defining `orig_num_tokens` as an optional field in the `ForwardBatch` dataclass definition to improve type safety and avoid static analysis warnings.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To improve type safety and avoid static analysis/type-checking warnings (e.g., from `mypy` or `pyright`), it is highly recommended to define `orig_num_tokens` as an optional field in the `ForwardBatch` dataclass definition rather than dynamically assigning it here.

For example, you can add the following field to the `ForwardBatch` class definition:
```python
orig_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None
```

+import unittest

+
+import requests
+

+from sglang.test.run_eval import run_eval
+from sglang.test.send_one import BenchArgs, send_one_prompt

+    DEFAULT_DRAFT_MODEL_STANDALONE_DP_ATTN,
+    DEFAULT_TARGET_MODEL_STANDALONE_DP_ATTN,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    is_in_amd_ci,
+    is_in_ci,
+    kill_process_tree,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    write_github_step_summary,
+)
+
+# STANDALONE with DP attention (tp=4, dp=4, requires 4 GPUs).
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="extra-b", runner_config="4-gpu-h100")
+register_amd_ci(est_time=200, suite="stage-c-test-4-gpu-amd")
+
+# Measured 0.950 (dp) / 0.945 (non-dp) on Qwen3-30B-A3B + Qwen3-0.6B.
+GSM8K_ACCURACY_FLOOR = 0.90
+# Measured ~3.93 on GSM8K (triton); margin for fa3 backend drift.
+SPEC_ACCEPT_LENGTH_FLOOR = 3.5
+
+
+class TestStandaloneSpecDPAttention(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = DEFAULT_TARGET_MODEL_STANDALONE_DP_ATTN
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        other_args = [
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--speculative-algorithm",
+            "STANDALONE",
+            "--speculative-draft-model-path",
+            DEFAULT_DRAFT_MODEL_STANDALONE_DP_ATTN,
+            "--speculative-num-steps",
+            "4",
+            "--speculative-eagle-topk",
+            "1",
+            "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+            "5",
+            "--tp-size",
+            "4",
+            "--dp-size",
+            "4",
+            "--enable-dp-attention",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "triton" if is_in_amd_ci() else "fa3",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.75",
+            "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+            "64",
+        ]
+        with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_BUSY.override(1):
+            cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+                cls.model,
+                cls.base_url,
+                timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+                other_args=other_args,
+            )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_a_gsm8k(self):
+        requests.get(self.base_url + "/flush_cache")
+
+        args = SimpleNamespace(
+            base_url=self.base_url,
+            model=self.model,
+            eval_name="gsm8k",
+            api="completion",
+            max_tokens=512,
+            num_examples=200,
+            num_threads=128,
+        )
+        metrics = run_eval(args)
+        print(f"{metrics=}")
+
+        server_info = requests.get(self.base_url + "/server_info").json()
+        avg_spec_accept_length = server_info["internal_states"][0][
+            "avg_spec_accept_length"
+        ]
+        print(f"{avg_spec_accept_length=}")
+
+        if is_in_ci():
+            write_github_step_summary(
+                f"### test_gsm8k (STANDALONE DP Attention)\n"
+                f'{metrics["score"]=:.3f}\n'
+                f"{avg_spec_accept_length=:.2f}\n"
+            )
+        self.assertGreater(metrics["score"], GSM8K_ACCURACY_FLOOR)
+        self.assertGreater(avg_spec_accept_length, SPEC_ACCEPT_LENGTH_FLOOR)
+
+    def test_b_bs1_acc_length(self):
+        args = BenchArgs(port=int(self.base_url.split(":")[-1]), max_new_tokens=256)
+        acc_length, speed = send_one_prompt(args)
+        print(f"{acc_length=:.2f} {speed=:.2f} token/s")
+
+        if is_in_ci():
+            write_github_step_summary(
+                f"### test_bs_1 (STANDALONE DP Attention)\n"
+                f"{acc_length=:.2f}\n"
+                f"{speed=:.2f} token/s\n"

## Code Review

This pull request enables support for standalone speculative decoding with DP (Data Parallel) attention. It removes the previous restriction, handles cases where standalone mode lacks hidden states or backup hidden states, configures the correct capture hidden mode for idle ranks to prevent NCCL hangs, and runs the draft worker in the attention TP group when DP attention is enabled. A test suite is also added to verify the implementation. The reviewer suggests defining `orig_num_tokens` as an optional field in the `ForwardBatch` dataclass definition to improve type safety and avoid static analysis warnings.
